title: 🤖 Week 29: Game AI
content:
🤖 Week 29: Game AI

This week, I finally finished Unity's AI course. The crowd simulation and Goal Driven Behavior sections were really fun and insightful!

Learning Agents in UE5

After Unity, I explored Unreal Engine’s Learning Agents.

Using Blueprints can be a bit tedious… I still prefer C++ for more control 😅.

ML-Agents in Unity

ML-Agents is a Unity package that makes training AI agents easier.

Highly recommend checking out Code Monkey’s tutorials:

How to use Machine Learning AI in Unity! (ML-Agents)

Teach your AI! Imitation Learning with Unity ML-Agents!

It’s amazing to see agents learn and adapt — makes game worlds feel alive! 🚀
